description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each illustrating the distribution of performance across four categories represented by different colors: N+K+ (teal), N–K+ (light yellow), N–K– (orange), and N+K– (red). The legend on the right identifies these categories. In the "easy" chart, the largest segment is N–K+ at 45.9%, followed by N+K+ at 40.6%, N–K– at 10.1%, and N+K– at 3.3%. The "medium" chart shows N+K+ as the largest segment at 44.6%, followed by N–K+ at 44.3%, N–K– at 7.2%, and N+K– at 3.9%. In the "hard" chart, N–K– is the largest segment at 36.8%, followed by N–K+ at 36.2%, N+K+ at 20.1%, and N+K– at 7.0%. Each slice in the pie charts is labeled with its corresponding percentage, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size within each chart.
